title: RoadRunner Scenario Writer
text: Write selected topic to RoadRunner scenario, 1 input, {Topic Category} sets Topic category; {Actor Type} sets the type of actor in scenario, {Topic} sets the actor or vehicle data and {Event Type} sets the type of event. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Actor Type
params.values: Type of actor in scenario All Types (default) | Vehicle

params.name: Topic
params.values: Actor or vehicle data Actor Pose | Actor Pose (Driving Scenario compatible) | Vehicle Pose

params.name: Event Type
params.values: Type of event Action Complete (default) | User-Defined
